name: Clocking in Cobb 2026
information:
**Please note that no food of any kind is allowed in the gymnasium.** Eating in the rest of the building is allowed, and a side room will also be open around lunch time to eat in.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClockinginCobb2026#77476-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
